# Presentation Power™

*The workshop that makes your message electric!*

Presented by: R.J. Foster, Wordsmith

In today’s multi-media world, it’s never been easier to be heard *or* more difficult to be listened to. When you speak to people, do they listen? Do they respond? If not, it’s time for the workshop that helps you discover the energy within you that makes you more engaging, more interesting, and more effective. It’s time to discover your PRESENTATION POWER!

## What’s in it?

- Six instructional hours (3-sessions)
- Small class size (8-people or less)
- Interactive discussions
- Individual presentations
- Group & individual coaching

## What’s in it for you?

- Tips and techniques for developing your unique presentation style
- More confidence speaking to a group
- Better connection with listeners
- Increased response to your message
